Quirk Sports.text: Quirk sports split every game into divisions, because Quirks made fair competition between ordinary bodies impossible. School clubs, amateur leagues and pro sports run Quirk-free divisions, with powers banned and checked by referees, alongside open divisions where registered Quirks play under sport-specific rules that group athletes by Quirk type, ban anything that could injure an opponent and make some Quirks fouls outright. Open matches need licensed venues, since they are public Quirk use under a permit. International competition shrank once countries could not agree on fair rules, and in Japan the U.A. Sports Festival drew the audience the Olympics lost. Baseball, soccer and swimming stay hugely popular in their Quirk-free forms.
